text: After the next hymn, Father whispered to Mother that he thought she'd better go out and air herself. After the second lesson, some of the church wardens came round to see if there were any dead rats in the church. Small people in our queue got up and went out, putting their handkerchiefs to their noses as they went. The pastor said they'd better close the service and hold a meeting outside to discuss the sanitary condition of the church. Mother and Father, Mother told Father they'd better go home one at a time.
